title: Drop In and Make Mosaic Art
includes: Everything is included! — Instruction, tools, and materials
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Drop-in mosaics are perfect for playful experimentation in your flexible, inclusive environment. It’s a great way to try something new, get your hands creatively busy, and experience one of the most satisfying artistic outlets in Austin. Come see why your mosaic drop-in is one of the city’s most inviting open studio experiences!
